A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work and complete 29-page material, including appendices and prompt templates. Text comparison and rendering establish that only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp and its link differ.

before.justification: v2.pdf reports original evaluations of 46 LLMs on IFEVAL++, prediction and training experiments, test-time scaling results, and supplementary analyses.

after.justification: v3.pdf retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–2 and the experiments in the appendices.

M1.justification: The cousin-prompt augmentation pipeline, code-assisted validity checker, and prediction, training, and test-time scaling procedures are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same IFEVAL, IFEVAL++, ALPACA, and curated cousin-prompt data, with identical constraint coverage and evaluation scenarios.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same 46 models; Table 2 retains verbalized confidence, perplexity, and probing. The training comparisons, including SFT versus DPO, are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Evaluation settings, splits, sample sizes, metrics, and training budgets are identical, including Section 4.1's decoding and prompt-strict evaluation and the 312-step training experiments.

E4.justification: The repeated-sampling comparison, word-count sensitivity, system-prompt tests, k-scaling, constraint-category analysis, and SFT/DPO analysis are retained without revision.

E5.justification: Repeated-sampling descriptions and seed information are unchanged. Neither version adds or revises uncertainty estimation, confidence intervals, or significance reporting relative to the other.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted trends, and qualitative findings match, including the appendix results. Table 1 reports the same reliable@10 scores of 78.4% for GPT-5 and 71.0% for LLaMA-3.3-70B-Instruct.

T1.justification: The reliable@k definition in Section 2.2 and the SFT objective in Appendix E.1 are identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about nuance-oriented reliability, IFEVAL++, model reliability gaps, and the three improvement approaches.

C2.justification: Scientific interpretations and applicability qualifications are identical, including all Section 8 limitations and the appendix discussion of training and reliability mechanisms.

D1.justification: Data corrections, model details, training hyperparameters, prompt templates, and code/benchmark access information are unchanged. The updated arXiv self-link only identifies the later document version.

R1.justification: The references and Appendix A's survey of 36 benchmarks are identical, as are the distinctions drawn between this work and prior reliability evaluations.

P1.justification: The first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv v2 dated 14 April 2026 to v3 dated 28 May 2026. All manuscript wording, headings, and organization remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, placements, and body layout are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–29 are pixel-identical; page 1 differs only in the administrative margin stamp.

improvement.justification: Only the arXiv version/date stamp and corresponding self-link change. The scientific content, evidence, explanations, presentation, and appendices are otherwise identical, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
